text:
ravi: Heads-up: publish is blocked by regendiff-check. It detected a minor bump because the CHANGELOG headings changed order after regen.

elaine: Can you paste the diff?

ravi: Tiny excerpt: 
```diff
-### Fixes
-
-- doc: clarify auth retry behavior
+### Improvements
+
+note: mention auto-retry for SDKs
```
No API or code change, just docs ordering.

ci-bot: regendiff-check failed at 1756602200. Log: https://ci.internal/regen/9988. Reason: inferred semver: minor.

ivan: We recently enabled stable-sort in codegen changelog concatenation (PR #432). That can reorder entries across regenerations.

morgan: Also seeing sample app tests failing after the same regen. The Go sample now observes 2 retries where it used to observe 1. Test: 
```go
if got := retries; got != 1 { t.Fatalf("want 1 retry; got %d", got) }
```
Locally pinning the previous typegen artifact makes test pass.

elain: That suggests two problems: changelog reorder and a behavioral default change in the generator. Can we inspect the typegen metadata?

ivan: Ran `typegen --inspect` on both artifacts. Diff: 
```yaml
- retry_policy:
-   max_retries: 1
+ retry_policy:
+   max_retries: 2
```
The generator default for Go was bumped.

ravi: For immediate unblock: (1) pin typegen artifact in the publish job, (2) patch regendiff-check to ignore CHANGELOG.md and docs-only paths when computing semver. I'll open the publish hotfix.

morgan: I'll file a ticket for the generator default change so codegen owners can decide if this is intentional or needs revert. Tagging INF-8602.

elain: Also adding a short-term test hardening: make the sample app assert the explicit client config (config.Retry.Max == 1) instead of implicit behavior. That decouples tests from generator defaults.

ravi: Update 1756603000: publish job pinned the previous typegen hash, reran, CI passed, release continues. Follow-ups: regendiff-check PR and INF-8602.

morgan: Thanks. Putting this on next devex sync agenda to discuss cross-SDK default governance and changelog-stable-sort consequences.
